made_in_jcc.f5: “JECK Comprehensive College did more than educate me. It transformed my mindset and unlocked my potential.”

stephanie.f2: From self-doubt to a Master’s degree.
stephanie.f3: Stephanie joined JECK in September 2012 as a JSS3 student. Before then, negative words at her previous school had left her doubting herself and believing she was not clever enough to succeed.
stephanie.f4: At JECK she found teachers who were supportive, encouraging and genuinely invested in every student, and a lively classroom where healthy competition pushed everyone to do their best. She challenged herself before her Junior WAEC exams, and that decision changed everything. By senior secondary she believed in herself, and reading became a daily habit.

l1.f2: Bachelor’s degree in Economics, University of Port Harcourt
National Youth Service in Ebonyi State
Pursuing certification with the Chartered Institute of Personnel Management (CIPM)
